hash_contract.method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC8785-JCS canonical JSON
hash_contract.interpretation: Remove ledger_sha256, ledger_hash, and any document-envelope generated_at, subject, and provenance members from the ledger object; canonicalize the remaining contract with RFC8785-JCS, encode it as UTF-8, and hash it with SHA-256.
hash_contract.compatibility: Per-parameter v1.1 JSON.stringify hashes remain inside each hash descriptor during schema migration.

interfaces.interpretation_boundary: The ledger records serialized boundary dtype, shape, and affine quantization facts and validates affine value/cardinality consistency. A FLOAT32 boundary is an explicit unquantized storage contract, not missing quantization metadata. This ledger alone does not establish RGB/BGR order, source-value normalization, mean/standard-deviation transforms, resize interpolation, application tensor layout, the production preprocessing implementation, mismatch prevalence, or task accuracy.

ledger_hash.method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC8785-JCS canonical JSON

payload_contract.interpretation: Remove ledger_sha256, ledger_hash, and any document-envelope generated_at, subject, and provenance members from the ledger object; canonicalize the remaining contract with RFC8785-JCS, encode it as UTF-8, and hash it with SHA-256.

findings.title: Some serialized tensor payload semantics are not assessed
findings.summary: 0/363 tensor payloads and 0/2,240,440,320 declared tensor bytes were numerically decoded. 363 tensor(s) remain explicit: undefined undefined: Payload numerical integrity requires --scan integrity or --scan full..
findings.interpretation: Container byte ranges are still conserved; no numerical result is inferred for an encoding whose source semantics are not implemented.
findings.recommendation: Use a source-pinned decoder for the listed encodings or convert to an assessed dtype before treating payload integrity as complete.

findings.title: Source checkpoint and conversion lineage were not provided
findings.summary: The artifact/report context does not provide source checkpoint SHA-256, export framework/version, converter version, export configuration, quantization/calibration configuration, representative dataset ID, build pipeline ID, software release ID, model requirement ID, or previous released artifact SHA-256.
findings.interpretation: The deployment artifact can be structurally analyzed, but it does not by itself establish traceability from training checkpoint to released runtime artifact.
findings.recommendation: Bind checkpoint-to-artifact lineage in the release manifest and include immutable hashes/IDs for source checkpoint, converter/framework, export options, calibration inputs where applicable, pipeline, software release, requirement, and previous artifact.

findings.title: Analyzer/rulepack/target-profile immutable identity is incomplete or dirty
findings.summary: Reproducibility gap(s): dirty analyzer source state. Analyzer commit 0b5aa05c12fa34b6ef60f0344dc6351d1b3551b6; source state working-tree-dirty; bundle content SHA-256 5db703fe2f2a8c5f3e76bdce7d38d7cb646408549b7109418384c62c6fa76cc1; rulepack SHA-256 efb41a87969114f6c60d7a2e8d20adbc80204aa25f517add1d0c76d303ea791a; target-profile SHA-256 not applicable to this artifact-only format assessment.
findings.interpretation: Date/version strings help humans, but a dirty analyzer commit does not identify the executed source; immutable analyzer, bundle-content, and rulepack identifiers plus the selected target-profile identifier are needed to reproduce exported evidence exactly.
findings.recommendation: Build release reports from a clean analyzer tree; for dirty development builds, embed the bundle content SHA-256 and still report the dirty source state explicitly. Embed analyzer and rulepack identifiers plus the selected target-profile identifier in every exported report and signed bundle.

findings.title: Representative-data validation not assessable
findings.summary: No training, validation, clinical, or representative calibration dataset is included in the deployment artifact.
findings.interpretation: Accuracy, clinical benefit, bias, subgroup performance, and generalizability cannot be concluded from this artifact alone.
findings.recommendation: Link this artifact report to external validation, calibration, and risk-management records.

kv_state_projection.formula: layers * kv_heads * (key_head_width + value_head_width) elements per token per batch
kv_state_projection.boundary: Element cardinality follows the declared attention-state dimensions. Byte values apply only when the runtime cache uses the supplied storage width and exclude allocator layout, paging, alignment, residency, and backend-private state.

tokenizer.array_evidence: Full array cardinalities are parsed; only bounded previews are retained in browser memory.

semantic_contract.boundary: Internal metadata consistency, declared attention-state cardinality, and an explicit canonical decoder compute scenario where registered only; an execution DAG, architecture implementation, tokenizer behavior, cache storage dtype/layout, backend support, and runtime allocation are not inferred.
semantic_contract.parameter_storage_basis: Reused from deepbom.tensor_storage_summary.v1; tensor shape products and serialized payload bytes are not recomputed.

storage.encoding_inventory_signature_basis: SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC8785-JCS canonical JSON of the complete emitted encoding_inventory array. Rows are ordered by exact serialized bytes descending, then dtype.
storage.tensor_encoding_assignment_signature_bas: SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC8785-JCS canonical JSON of tensor rows sorted by numeric index then name and projected to index, name, dtype, shape, and byte_length.
storage.recipe_interpretation: Content-addressed serialized encoding inventory and tensor-to-encoding assignment only. Quantizer command, converter build, importance matrix, source checkpoint, and recipe authenticity are not inferred.

layer_storage.boundary: Exact serialized tensor bytes grouped by a source-registered or format-canonical layer namespace. These bytes are not runtime packing, replicas, allocator usage, residency, offload capacity, engine workspace, or physical transfer.

storage.basis: Reused from deepbom.tensor_storage_summary.v1; no independent recount.

tokenizer.array_evidence: Full array cardinalities are parsed; only bounded previews are retained in browser memory.

kv_projection.formula: layers * kv_heads * (key_head_width + value_head_width) elements per token per batch
kv_projection.boundary: Element cardinality follows the declared attention-state dimensions. Byte values apply only when the runtime cache uses the supplied storage width and exclude allocator layout, paging, alignment, residency, and backend-private state.

state.scenario_boundary: KV byte rows are conditional on context, batch, and cache storage width. They are not runtime allocation, residency, paging, or device-memory measurements.

compute.boundary: Architecture equations are static scenarios, not a serialized execution graph, lowered kernel count, latency estimate, or throughput measurement.

profiles.label: Vulkan
profiles.runtime_disable_condition: GGML_DISABLE_VULKAN environment variable must be absent

gguf_backend_prerequisites.method: Match general.architecture against the pinned llama.cpp registry, validate every serialized tensor layout against pinned GGML traits, and enumerate backend CMake option plus compiled registration gates. Do not infer runtime graph operator support, device availability, offload, fallback, or execution.
gguf_backend_prerequisites.boundary: A source candidate is not an executable compatibility result. Bind the exact llama.cpp binary/build manifest and an artifact-identified runtime capture to conclude backend availability or execution.

files.purpose: EngineConfig serialization, BuildConfig limits, KV-cache type, plugin configuration, and weight-streaming declaration.
PretrainedConfig architecture dimensions, distributed mapping, and quantization/KV-cache quantization fields.
world_size = tp_size x pp_size x cp_size and pipeline-layer partition rules.

memory_feasibility.residency_assumption: All serialized tensor bytes and the logical state bytes are simultaneously resident in one aggregate primary-memory budget; storage-backed weight paging, remote execution, and capacity split across independently constrained memory pools are excluded.
memory_feasibility.boundary: Under the explicit simultaneous-residency assumption, static rows add exact serialized tensor bytes to logical KV/SSM state bytes. A smaller aggregate capacity is insufficient only under that assumption. A capacity at or above the lower bound is not proven sufficient. A v2 artifact-bound runtime manifest may separately account for working-memory categories, but per-pool capacity, application memory, and operating-system reserve remain external.

static_memory_placement.boundary: No per-pool placement result is emitted until an artifact-bound static memory profile declares both capacities, reserves, and residency policy.

evidence_boundary: Serialized artifact facts and deterministic static derivations. Declarations and runtime measurements are accepted only through separately identified inputs.
